description: Read where one of the user's registrations stands: status, stage, next action and action_path, which form sections are done, missing or invalid fields (names only), each document's status and what's wrong with it, payment status, whether their NIN is confirmed, and for a queried registration CAC's reason plus each flagged item with its fix_path and whether it's resolved. It never includes personal details (NIN, date of birth, phone, addresses); those are on the registration page.
name: get_registration_state
title: Check a registration's progress
